scripts.forge:fmt: cd contracts && forge fmt && forge fmt script/
scripts.check:storage: cd contracts && forge build && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract OllaCore --fixture upgrade/fixtures/OllaCore.storage.json && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract OllaVault --fixture upgrade/fixtures/OllaVault.storage.json && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract RewardsAccumulator --fixture upgrade/fixtures/RewardsAccumulator.storage.json && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract StakingManager --fixture upgrade/fixtures/StakingManager.storage.json && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract StakingProviderRegistry --fixture upgrade/fixtures/StakingProviderRegistry.storage.json && tsx script/check-storage-layout.ts --contract OllaGovernance --fixture upgrade/fixtures/OllaGovernance.storage.json
scripts.check:storage:update: cd contracts && forge build && bash -c 'for c in OllaCore OllaVault RewardsAccumulator StakingManager StakingProviderRegistry OllaGovernance; do forge inspect $c storage-layout --json > upgrade/fixtures/$c.storage.json && echo "Updated $c"; done'
scripts.slither:docker: docker build -f contracts/Dockerfile.slither -t olla-slither:local . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/contracts:/work" -w /work olla-slither:local slither . --config-file slither.config.json
scripts.test: yarn test:unit && yarn test:invariant && yarn test:integration && yarn test:interface-compat
scripts.deploy:local: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" bash -lc 'set -a; . ./contracts/.example-local.env; set +a; forge script ./contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol:DeployScript --root ./contracts --broadcast --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545'
